newsitem.title: ITALY: Smart car looks for strong sales in Italy.
newsitem.headline: Smart car looks for strong sales in Italy.

text.p: Smart, the compact two-seater car being built by Mercedes-Benz AG and the Swiss SMH-Swatch group, is aiming for sales of up to 70,000 units in Italy, Swatch chairman Nicolas Hayek said on Thursday.
He told reporters in Bologna, Italy, that the car would be sold in Italy for 11,000 Swiss francs following its launch in early 1998.

"We are aiming to sell 10,000 to 20,000 cars in the first year and we hope to improve to 60,000 to 70,000 for the following years," Hayek said. "In Italy there is an excellent market for the city car," he added.
The Smart will be launched in Austria, Belgium, France, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Spain and Switzerland.
Annual sales are projected to reach 200,000 units by 2000.
